english.notes: The programme is taught in German, so the language requirement recorded here is GERMAN, not English: A2 must be proven when registering for the Aufnahmeverfahren (A2 certificates not older than 2 years), C1 at the time of admission (Zulassung) (C1 certificates not older than 3 years; accepted: ÖSD C1, Goethe C1, telc C1 Hochschule, DSH-2, ÖIF C1, VWU Ergänzungsprüfung). An applicant may sit the entrance test before holding C1. No English test (IELTS/TOEFL) is required for this programme; the only English-language bachelor exception on the Aufnahmeverfahren site is Mathematical Foundations of Data Science.

value.description: No grade/GPA threshold. Admission is by a written entrance test (Aufnahmeverfahren); school grades play no role and Austria has no numerus clausus. 415 places shared between Informatik and Wirtschaftsinformatik.

Also read /fristen-und-termine and /aktuell.
deadline.notes: THIS IS THE 2026/27 CYCLE (intake winter semester 2026/27), not 2027/28. As of 2026-10-17 the university has not published the registration period for the 2027/28 Aufnahmeverfahren; it states it expects to announce the 2027/28 deadlines around the end of 2026. The 2026/27 dates were announced on 01.10.2025. The registration deadline (Antragsfrist) for the Aufnahmeverfahren is the same for all applicants incl. third-country nationals; the written test was 13 July 2026 in Vienna; the subsequent general Zulassungsfrist for WS 2026/27 was 13 July to 31 October 2026. A search of mtbl.univie.ac.at for a 2026/27 Mitteilungsblatt with 2027 dates returned only the 2025/26 issue (dates for 2026).

tuition.how_found: Search "Studienbeitrag Drittstaatsangehörige Universität Wien Semester Euro" -> result "Höhe des Studien-/ÖH-Beitrags" (studieren.univie.ac.at). Section "Höhe Nicht-EU/EWR". The older URL /studienbeitrag/hoehe-studienbeitrag/ returned 404.
tuition.notes: Amounts are for Nicht-EU/EWR citizens without equal status (Gleichstellung): tuition 726,72 EUR + ÖH-Beitrag 26,20 EUR = 752,92 EUR per semester, payable from the first semester. Neither the German nor the English page names a semester or academic year for these amounts, so 2027/28 is not confirmed; this is the latest published figure. The page lists exceptions (citizens of certain developing countries, Ukrainian citizens, pay only the ÖH-Beitrag); whether Kazakhstan is on the exception list was not verified.

scholarship_exists.how_found: https://studieren.univie.ac.at/studieren-und-lernen/finanzielles/ -> card "Stipendien" -> /studieren-und-lernen/finanzielles/stipendien -> links "Leistungsstipendium" and "Förderungsstipendium" -> studienpraeses.univie.ac.at pages; also https://studienpraeses.univie.ac.at/stipendien/ overview. Searches "Stipendium internationale Studierende Bachelor Studienanfänger Universität Wien ..." and "international.univie.ac.at scholarship international degree-seeking students bachelor ..." found only exchange/summer-school scholarships.
scholarship_exists.notes: The university does not publish an explicit sentence saying it offers no scholarship for incoming bachelor applicants; not_applicable is inferred from its published scholarship list: the only university-administered scholarships for degree students (Leistungsstipendium nach dem StudFG, Förderungsstipendium nach dem StudFG) are awarded retrospectively for completed coursework (Leistungsstipendium) or for an unfinished thesis (Förderungsstipendium), i.e. to already-enrolled students; an incoming 2027 applicant cannot be considered at application. The Leistungsstipendium is awarded once a year (Antragsfrist 1.10.2026-3.11.2026 for Studienjahr 2025/26 achievements), so an enrolled international bachelor student could apply after their first study year subject to Gleichstellung. Other listed sources (Studienbeihilfe/stipendium.at, grants.at, ÖH database, AK) are external, not university-run. International Office scholarships found are for exchange stays and summer/winter schools only.

scholarship_international.notes: No scholarship for incoming applicants exists to evaluate (see scholarship_exists). For the nearest candidate, the Leistungsstipendium nach dem StudFG, non-Austrian citizens are eligible only if they are 'gleichgestellt' (equal status) under the Studienförderungsgesetz; the university links an information sheet on this for non-Austrian citizens. The PDF could not be read with the available fetch tool (binary), so the exact equal-status conditions for a Kazakh third-country national are not recorded here; a freshly arrived third-country student would need to check that sheet.

access_notes: Several legacy studieren.univie.ac.at URLs returned HTTP 404 (the site has been restructured): /studienangebot/bachelor-und-diplomstudien/informatik-bachelor-mit-aufnahmeverfahren/, /studienbeitrag/hoehe-studienbeitrag/, /zulassung/bachelor-diplomstudien/zulassung-ohne-osa/nicht-euewr-mit-deutsch/, and the English glossary entry on grants. The central programme list now points Informatik directly to aufnahmeverfahren.univie.ac.at/informatik.

Faculty pages informatik.univie.ac.at/en/study/courses-of-study/bachelor/bachelor-informatik/ and informatik.univie.ac.at/studium/studienangebot/bachelor/ returned 404; the search snippet for the faculty's current Bachelor Informatik (Version 2022) page mentions 'Deutsch & Englisch' as teaching languages, but that page could not be opened, so the programme record uses the admissions page's 'Deutsch (Zulassungsvoraussetzung)'.
URLs under www.univie.ac.at/fuers-studium-bewerben/... (fristen, sprachkenntnisse/deutsch, laenderspezifische-voraussetzungen) that one fetched page referenced all returned 404.

PDFs (Erläuterungen Vergabe Leistungsstipendium, Infoblatt Gleichstellung, Mitteilungsblatt issues) are returned as binary by the fetch tool; per task rules no local file processing was done, so their text was not quoted.

The fetch tool's summariser capped some verbatim quotes at ~125 characters; quotes recorded are the exact segments it returned (e.g. the Leistungsstipendium sentences are truncated fragments, marked as such by their length).
No local repository files or skills were read, per the task's isolation rule. No login, no robots bypass.
